Fixation of nitrogen cannot be done independently.

Target Crops: All types of pulses and oilseeds.

Direction for use:

Seed Treatment: Take 20 ml Kheti Rakshak along with 30 ml of water mixed with 1 kg of seed and dry the seed under shade before sowing or before 24 hours of sowing.

Soll Treatment: Take 1 lit. Of Kheti Rakshak along with fym or carrier and mix it well. Broadcast the contention of 1 acre of land before the last ploughing.

Drip Irrigation: Mix 2.5m! of Kheti Rakshak per 1 liter of water.

Root/Set Treatment: Take 250ml Kheti Rakshak mix with 4-5 liter of water. Dip the required seeding of 1 acre in this solution for 20-30 minutes. Transplant the treated seedling as early as possible.

Caution: Store the biofertilizer bottle in a cool and dry place. Avoid direct heating or sunlight on the bio-fertilizer bottle. Shake well before use.

Before diving into Gno Rules, it is essential that you learn how to set up the game.

Each player must be dealt seven cards face-down.

Place all of the remaining cards face-down to form a draw pile.

Next, take the top card from the draw pile and place it face-up nearby to begin the discard pile.

With both the draw and discard piles in place, you are ready to begin.

Generally, the player to the dealer’s left will go first.

However, you may also choose a player to begin or select the youngest player, oldest player, etc.

This card game has a clockwise turn rotation.
